content.title: About
content.content: Beans and rice with meat is a classic dish that combines protein‑rich beans, carbohydrate‑dense rice, and lean meat (usually beef or pork). It provides a balanced nutrient profile, offers lasting satiety, and works well for lunch or dinner.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The bean‑grain combination supplies a complete amino‑acid profile, making the meal a full protein source.
In different countries the dish has local names: in Latin America it’s “arroz con frijoles”, in Spain “fabada con arroz”.
Traditionally beans are soaked overnight to reduce cooking time and improve digestibility.
Meat is often browned with onion and spices first, which deepens the flavor.
The dish is commonly garnished with fresh herbs, lime, or chili sauce for extra zest.

items.title: Rich plant protein
items.content: Beans provide about 21 g of protein per 100 g, making them an excellent protein source for vegetarians, and when paired with meat they form a complete protein.

items.title: Complex carbohydrates
items.content: Rice delivers slow‑releasing energy, helping maintain stable blood‑sugar levels.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Both meat and beans are high in vitamin B6, niacin, and folate, which are essential for metabolism.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: The meal supplies iron, zinc, magnesium, and potassium, supporting heart and muscle function.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: Beans and whole‑grain rice provide fiber that promotes healthy digestion.

items.title: Digestive issues
items.content: Some people experience gas from beans; thorough rinsing and soaking can lessen this effect.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: If the recipe includes soy sauce or added salt, sodium levels can be high; monitor salt usage.

items.title: Bean allergy
items.content: Rarely, individuals may be allergic to beans; discontinue use if any reaction occurs.

items.title: Meat quality
items.content: Use fresh, reputable cuts of meat to avoid food‑borne illness.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Soak beans for 8–12 hours, then boil until tender. Cook rice separately. Sauté meat with onion, garlic, and spices (paprika, cumin, black pepper). Combine beans, rice, and meat, add broth, and simmer 15–20 minutes until flavors meld. Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the cooked dish in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3‑4 days. It can be frozen for up to 2 months; thaw in the fridge and reheat before serving.
